import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality with Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Physical Activity Level distribution by Occupation
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(6).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.boxplot(data=df_top_occ, x='Occupation', y='Physical Activity Level', 
            ax=axes[0, 1], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Sleep metrics by BMI Category
bmi_metrics = df.groupby('BMI Category')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
bmi_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 2], color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'])
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Metrics by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend(['Sleep Duration (hours)', 'Quality of Sleep (1-10)'])

# 4. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Daily Steps distribution by Gender and Sleep Disorder
df_sleep_disorder = df.copy()
df_sleep_disorder['Sleep Disorder'] = df_sleep_disorder['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sns.violinplot(data=df_sleep_disorder, x='Gender', y='Daily Steps', 
               hue='Sleep Disorder', split=True, ax=axes[1, 1], palette='Set3')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps by Gender and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 6. Age distribution with Sleep Duration overlay
age_bins = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=range(20, 70, 5))
age_sleep = df.groupby(age_bins)['Sleep Duration'].mean()
age_counts = df.groupby(age_bins).size()

ax2 = axes[1, 2].twinx()
bars = axes[1, 2].bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, 
                      alpha=0.6, color='lightblue', label='Count')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Number of People', fontsize=12, color='lightblue')
axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='lightblue')
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in age_counts.index], rotation=45)

line = ax2.plot(range(len(age_sleep)), age_sleep.values, 
                color='darkred', marker='o', linewidth=2, label='Avg Sleep Duration')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, color='darkred')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='darkred')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Age Distribution with Average Sleep Duration', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Combine legends
lines, labels = axes[1, 2].get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
axes[1, 2].legend(lines + lines2, labels + labels2, loc='upper right')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
